packageRules.description: Skip Postgres major bumps — they require data migration, not a tag bump.
linuxserver tags are <semver>-<gitsha>-lsN; Renovate's default docker versioning treats the tail as opaque and skips bumps. Loose versioning matches on the leading semver.
Auto-merge minor/patch bumps for stateless leaf apps. Major bumps still require review. Needs GitHub Settings → General → 'Allow auto-merge' enabled at repo level.

Pin nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm — 26.06 segfaults in cuStreamCreateWithPriority on GB10 with driver 595. Docker versioning can't parse the -py3 suffix, so allowedVersions is a regex allowing 20.xx-py* through 26.04-py*.
